description: The AppHost can now create and own interactive terminal processes independent of resources orchestrated by DCP, via new experimental `TerminalService`, `AspireTerminal`, and `TerminalLaunchOptions` APIs. Terminals can be placed in the dashboard dock, shown in a dialog via `IInteractionService.PromptTerminalAsync`, or run headlessly for automation, enabling scenarios like authenticating an external tool or running interactive setup from AppHost code.
name: AppHost-owned interactive terminals
